text: The world's deadliest assassin took a contract to eliminate a ruthless king,
and broke into the wrong palace... without his glasses.
Half-blind, Viper dropped through a roof straight into a smoky room,
mistaking the royal kitchen for the throne room.
Before he could escape, the terrifying head chef cornered him with a giant cleaver.
Thinking fast, Viper dipped a finger into a bubbling pot of mysterious green stew.
Even though it tasted like boiled socks,
he let out a dramatic gasp... and called it a masterpiece.
Overwhelmed, the chef burst into tears of joy.
Nobody had ever praised his cooking before.
Even better, he invited Viper to help serve the king's private dinner.
Royal guards checked every tray, completely ignoring the hooded assassin carrying a silver platter.
Viper reached the throne in seconds.
He spent the next week recovering from food poisoning.
